entities.name: ZaniniRenovations
observations: PHP application based on Laravel 9
Renovation and Carpentry Services Website
Memory graph persisted at .cursor/memory-graph.json in the project root (configured via MCP server-memory --path).

entities.name: Architecture
observations: Standard Laravel MVC structure
Models located in app/Models/ (e.g., Client, Project, Quotation models)
Controllers located in app/Http/Controllers/
Routing uses standard Laravel routes/web.php and routes/api.php
Views are built using Blade templates and connect to controllers via the view() helper (e.g., view('site.blog.index')).
Layouts (like public.blade.php) utilize standard Blade directives such as @yield, @include, and @stack.
Configuration values are managed in .env and accessed via config() or env() helpers.

entities.name: Database
observations: Uses MySQL connection configured via .env and config/database.php
Strict mode is enabled in config/database.php
Table naming convention follows plural snake_case (e.g., client_projects, paving_stone_types).
Database schema is versioned using timestamped migrations.

entities.name: CodingStandards
observations: Uses PSR-4 autoloading for the App namespace
Does not strictly enforce declare(strict_types=1) across the app directory
Uses standard PascalCase for classes and controllers
Formatting follows standard PSR-12 conventions.
Variable and method names use camelCase (e.g., $categorySlug, incrementViews).
Error handling leverages Laravel's built-in exceptions like abort(404).
PHP 8 features like short closures (fn () => ...) are actively used.

entities.name: Dependencies
observations: Requires PHP ^8.0
Uses barryvdh/laravel-dompdf and spatie/browsershot for PDF generation
Uses guzzlehttp/guzzle for HTTP requests
Frontend relies on Bootstrap, FontAwesome, Owl Carousel, and Venobox.
CSS and JS files are served directly from the public/ directory with custom timestamp-based cache busting instead of Webpack/Vite.
package.json only includes puppeteer, which supports the spatie/browsershot backend package.

entities.name: ExternalAPIs
observations: Integrates with Gmail SMTP
Integrates with Mocean SMS
Integrates with Google Maps Platform (Places API, Distance Matrix API)
Integrates with Google Photos Picker API
Integrates with Google Gemini API for AI features
Integrates with SerpApi for material price scraping
Frontend utilizes Google Analytics 4 (configured via SEO_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID).
